type: Assistant diagnostic review, not human ratings; no numerical scores overridden
observations: Reviewed contact sheets of all primary crops and additional candidates for all 15 photos.
Historical February mug candidates are indistinct background regions, illustrating false positive localization.
October mug candidates include a glass mug, bowls and dark handled vessels; these do not establish presence of the canonical blue mug.
October control cap is visible near the door but no candidate passes the frozen threshold.
Wide bicycle crops include a person and background; their cosine can change with composition, not only the bicycle.
Scores and the highest-detector-confidence selection rule were preserved; no handpicked replacement crops or manual scores were substituted.
decision: Use as exploratory algorithmic object-reference similarity with candidate coverage and crop inspection. Do not call it object accuracy or count the new metric as a generation improvement.
